decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the board through powerful spells and planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to secure victory. The deck includes a variety of lands to ensure mana fixing and consistency, along with versatile removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude. Leyline Binding helps to further lock down the opponent's threats, while cards like Fury and Lightning Bolt provide additional removal and reach. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through efficient control strategies.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence with Omnath, Locus of Creation. Prismatic Ending, Solitude, and Fury provide removal options for threats, while Leyline Binding helps lock down key cards from the opponent. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines can be a game-ending threat if resolved. The deck also includes Boseiju, Who Endures to ensure key spells can't be countered. Nissa, Resurgent Animist and The One Ring provide additional value and utility.

The main concept of this deck is to take control of the game through the use of powerful and versatile artifacts, such as Mindslaver and Walking Ballista, while ramping up mana quickly with the Urza lands. Karn, the Great Creator acts as a toolbox for finding key artifacts, while cards like Remand and Condescend provide control and disruption. The deck aims to establish an overwhelming advantage through card advantage and powerful threats, ultimately outpacing and outmaneuvering the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing low mana cost spells and efficient creatures to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By combining powerful aggro cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent with counterspells and removal spells, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a strong board presence. The inclusion of cantrips like Expressive Iteration and Consider help to maintain card advantage and find key pieces, while Mishra's Bauble provides additional card selection. This deck aims to win the game through fast and aggressive plays while maintaining control over the battlefield.

The main idea of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while also using disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect your threats. Murktide Regent and Unholy Heat serve as powerful removal options to clear the way for your creatures. Expressive Iteration helps with card selection and card advantage. The deck aims to close out games quickly by maintaining a strong board presence and controlling the opponent's plays with a mix of counterspells and removal.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The deck focuses on playing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. Blood Moon can also shut down opposing multicolor decks, giving this Rakdos Aggro deck a powerful edge. The deck also includes some recursion and protection elements with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death, allowing for flexibility and resilience in combat.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to apply early pressure on the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the opponent's game plan. Feign Death and Undying Malice enable powerful synergies with creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Orcish Bowmasters. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can serve as a finisher, and cards like Blood Moon and Fury provide additional disruption and reach. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, disruptive, and consistent in applying pressure to win games quickly.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive play with a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The goal is to quickly apply pressure to the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with any opposing threats. The deck also has ways to protect its creatures and generate value with Feign Death and Undying Malice. Finally, the deck includes a Blood Moon to disrupt opponents relying on nonbasic lands.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play Primeval Titan and utilize its ability to search for lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal damage. The combination of Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands allows for explosive plays and the potential to generate large amounts of mana. The deck also includes other utility lands and cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to further enhance ramp and search capabilities. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces efficiently and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. The key strategy is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent's life total with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while using cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate to disrupt their game plan. The deck also features ways to bring back creatures from the graveyard and generate card advantage with Seasoned Pyromancer. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Leyline Binding. By utilizing cards such as Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to protect and draw into combo pieces, the deck aims to set up explosive plays and overwhelm the opponent. Thoughtseize helps disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Kroxa and Kunoros provide additional disruption and utility. Overall, the goal of the deck is to combo off and win the game before the opponent can establish a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful control cards to dominate the battlefield and outpace the opponent. With a strong mana base and card selection tools like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone provide additional control options, while finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring can quickly close out the game. The deck aims to control the board state, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and ultimately overwhelm them with powerful threats.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and spells that have the Cascade ability, allowing you to cast additional spells for free. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent quickly by getting multiple threats on the board while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal. The deck also includes various land types to support the mana requirements of the spells and creatures in the deck. Overall, the strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent while controlling the game with versatile spells and Cascade effects.

The main concept of this aggro red deck is to deal fast and consistent damage to the opponent. By utilizing burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Skullcrack, Lava Spike, and Searing Blaze, along with creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, the goal is to quickly reduce the opponent's life total to zero. This deck also includes cards like Roiling Vortex and Boros Charm to disrupt the opponent's strategies and protect your own creatures. With a focus on speed and aggression, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt your opponent's hand and board presence with cards like Thoughtseize, Grief, and Dauthi Voidwalker while also putting pressure on your opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also utilizes tricks like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect your creatures and ensure that you maintain control of the game. Through a combination of disruption and aggression, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm your opponent and secure a victory in the Modern 1 vs 1 format.
